title: every defer runs; the body failure outranks defer failures
purpose: Observe failure, cleanup and lifetime ordering during execution.

stdout.text:
defer after failing one
last registered runs first
body failure wins

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 19: every registered defer runs even if one fails; an existing body failure has precedence over defer failures.
